# Awesome Agentic Loops / Agentic Loop Atlas

Use this repository to find and design bounded AI-agent loops.

Rules for agents:
- Prefer loops with proof, stopping_condition, approval_gate, and cost_guard.
- Do not run destructive, service, credential, billing, or external-message actions without explicit human approval.
- Start with one bounded iteration.
- End with a receipt and next-loop plan.
- If no loop fits, design a new Loop Card using schemas/loop-card.schema.json.

Important files:
- README.md — human overview
- catalog.json — machine-readable catalog
- schemas/loop-card.schema.json — required fields
- docs/risk-taxonomy.md — safety levels
- docs/platform-matrix.md — agent/runtime compatibility
- loops/ — loop cards
- examples/ — proof receipts
